verses.text: Ha in Oseas in tik, yuninal in winhaj Beeri, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin ayik ix yak'an reyal heb' winh tik t'a chonhab' Judá: Haton winhaj Uzías, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Acaz yet' winhaj Ezequías. Haxo t'a Israel a winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Joás ayoch reyal. Haton t'a tik tz'ib'ab'ilkan tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin.

Ayik ix scha'anel yich Jehová slolon t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik: Ha heb' etisraelal, te chuk sk'ulej heb' t'a wichanh, ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'ayin icha junok ix ajmul ix. Yuj chi', a junok ix ajmul ix tzik' etb'eyumok. Ay heb' yune' ix ol aljok t'a yajmulal, xchi t'ayin.
Yuj chi' ix wik' ix skuchan Gomer yisil winhaj Diblaim wetb'eyumok. Ixlajwi chi' ix skuchanoch yune' ix, ix alji jun in winak unin yet' ix.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Jezreel ol ak' sb'iej winh unin chi', yujto t'a yik jaye' k'ual tik, ol wak'och sya'elal heb' yinhtilal winhaj rey Jehú yuj jantak anima ix smilcham heb' t'a chonhab' Jezreel. Ol wak'pax lajwokel chonhab' Israel chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol in satel heb' soldado Israel t'a lum sch'olanil Jezreel chi', xchi t'ayin.

Ix skuchanxioch yune' ix Gomer chi', ix unin jun yune' ix, ix alji. Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: “Manh-xajanab'ilok” tzak' sb'iej ix isil chi', yujto manhxo ol ok' in k'ol t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Manhxo ol wak'laj niwank'olal.

Haxo pax chonhab' Judá, ol ok' in k'ol t'ay. Ha in Jehová in sDiosal in heb' ol in kolo', palta manhok yet' heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal, palta yet' in poder ol in kol heb', xchi.
Haxo yik toxo ix el ix unin chi' t'a yim, ix skuchanxioch yune' ix Gomer chi', ix alji junxo swinak unin ix.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: “Manh-in-chonhab'ok”, icha chi' tzak' sb'iej winh unin chi', yujto a ex israel ex tik, manhxo in chonhab'ok eyaji, manhxo in he Diosalok.

Palta ay wal jun k'ual, lajan ol ajxi sb'isul heb' israel tik icha yarenail sti' ha' mar, malaj mach syal sb'isani. Ha b'aj ix wal t'a heb' icha tik: “Manh-ex-in-chonhab'ok”, xin chi, hata' ol alchaj t'a heb': Yuninal ex Dios pitzan.
Ol smolb'ej sb'a heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel t'a jun pekti' chi', junxonhej yajalil heb' ol yak'ochi. Ol te k'echa'anh heb', yujto te niwan yelk'och jun k'ual yik Jezreel chi'.
